newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden debt, crown hold strength before EMU news.
newsitem.headline: Sweden debt, crown hold strength before EMU news.

text.p: Swedish bond yields kept their initial strength in line with stronger foreign markets on Tuesday morning while the crown firmed slightly against the German mark.
Trade was quite thin ahead of the ruling Social Democrats' announcement of the party's EMU-stance that was due to be released officially for the first time at 1430 GMT.
Dealers said sentiment was quite positive ahead of the announcement.
"I would be surprised if it were to be something you could interpret as negative," said one currency dealer.
"A qualified rejection is already priced in."
He expected the crown could firm against the mark after the announcement.
The six month T-bill rate fell two basis points to 4.23 percent and the ten year bond yield fell six basis points to 6.95 percent.
The crown firmed to 4.5090 crowns to the mark versus 4.5120 crowns late on Monday.
